ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard modeling electricity and heating fluctuations across historic University of Toronto campus buildings to minimize peak energy waste.
ideas.title: UofT Campus Carbon & Energy Grid Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous statistical forecasting similar to past winning AI incident forecasting projects, solving a concrete sustainability problem relevant to local campus infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-agent student support and mental health resource navigator tailored specifically to UofT's collegiate system and insurance coverage rules.
ideas.title: St. George Student Health Multi-Agent Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the multi-agent RAG architecture of the GreenNovation win, customized precisely to an acute student pain point at UofT.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered commute routing platform that forecasts TTC subway crowding and delays using real-time GTFS feeds and historical weather conditions.
ideas.title: Toronto Transit Delay & Crowd Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on local Toronto infrastructure data, immediately capturing judge interest by solving daily commuter frustrations.

ideas.pitch: A localized commerce marketplace for student clubs and Toronto downtown vendors featuring transparent USDC escrow payments and instant automated fulfillment.
ideas.title: Local Vendor Micro-Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven autonomous escrow patterns from recent fintech wins to create a polished, functional financial demo within the 71-hour window.

ideas.pitch: An automated computer vision and nutrition tracking tool that scans UofT dining hall menus to build personalized macronutrient plans for student athletes.
ideas.title: NutriUofT Campus Dining Nutritionist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the rapid implementation style of the E-Foodiee nutrition assistant win, integrating local dining hall datasets for immediate utility.
